title: Pine and juniper room spray
subtitle: A sharp, resinous room spray for living spaces
excerpt: A room spray of Scots pine and juniper berry essential oils in perfumers' alcohol and distilled water. Pine gives a sharp, green-resinous note; juniper is berry-fresh with a dry, gin-like quality. A clean, non-sweet scent that suits living rooms and hallways. Makes 100 ml. Shelf life 12 months.
sourceNotes: Scots pine EO (Pinus sylvestris): alpha-pinene dominant, green-resinous; good room spray note. Flash point ~50°C, dissolve in alcohol before adding water; the ethanol stabilises it in spray form. Juniper berry EO (Juniperus communis berry, not needles): alpha-pinene + sabinene + myrcene; fresh, gin-like, slightly fruity-dry. 70:30 pine:juniper ratio gives a clean, balanced blend without either dominating. Total EO load 3-4% in a room spray is standard. Not a skin product, IFRA leave-on limits for pinene compounds are much lower, but room spray disperses too quickly to be a dermal exposure concern.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Mature for 24 hours before first use. Shake before each use.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 12 months sealed. Pine and juniper are both high in terpenes, which oxidise relatively quickly, keep away from heat and light. The spray remains usable for 12 months but the sharp, bright top note fades after 6 months.

glossaryTerms.definition: A class of volatile compounds (alpha-pinene, limonene, myrcene) that form the sharp top notes of conifer and citrus essential oils. Monoterpenes are the most volatile part of a room spray and the first to fade.

content.text: Pine and juniper room spray is a resinous, clean-scented spray for living rooms and hallways. Scots pine brings the sharp green-resinous top note; juniper berry adds a dry, berry-fresh quality, the combination is reminiscent of a walk through a winter forest. Both oils are high in
and throw a vivid initial scent that fades quickly in the room, that is the nature of terpene volatility. Makes 100 ml; keeps 12 months.

content.text: Add the essential oils to the perfumers' alcohol in the spray bottle. Swirl to dissolve.
Add the distilled water. Cap and shake. Leave 24 hours to mature before first use.
Shake before each use. Spray into the centre of the room.
12 months in a sealed bottle away from heat and light. Pine and juniper terpenes oxidise faster than most EOs, use within 12 months for the best scent.
